discom: MVVNL - LESA (Lucknow Electricity Supply Admin), EUDD-Mahanagar
petitioner: Smt. Shabina w/o Mohammad Rais (525-A/046, Sector-A, Mahanagar)
secondary_subjects: Non-compliance of prior Ombudsman order; re-assessment
procedural_posture: Non-compliance / execution petition re prior Ombudsman order (Petn 113/2020, dt 03.02.2021)
key_provision_interpreted: Reg 3.10 (2022) bar on theft/UUE; EA s.126/135/127
ratio_short: CGRF/Ombudsman have no jurisdiction over theft or unauthorised-use assessment (s.126/135); remedy is s.127 appellate authority / Special Court; Reg 3.10 (2022) bars the forum from entertaining such complaints.

petitioner: Maa Shakumbhari Plastic Udyog (prop. Vipul Arora)
secondary_subjects: Review / recall of Ombudsman's own order
procedural_posture: Review / recall petition of Ombudsman order (Rep 21/2025, dt 05.12.2025)
maintainability_holding: Not maintainable (no review jurisdiction; no O.47 ground)
precedents_cited: CPC s.114 r/w Order XLVII Rule 1
key_provision_interpreted: CPC Order XLVII R.1 review standard + absence of review power in Regs
ratio_short: The Electricity Ombudsman has no statutory power to review/recall its own order; review lies only on CPC Order XLVII grounds (new evidence undiscoverable with due diligence, or error apparent on the face of the record); re-argument of already-considered facts is not a ground.

ombudsman: Electricity Ombudsman, U.P. (name illegible in OCR)
petitioner: M/s Om Industries, rice mill (prop. Ram Babu)
secondary_subjects: Non-compliance of CGRF order; re-assessment / adjustment
procedural_posture: Non-compliance / execution of CGRF order (CGRF Ayodhya Case 14/2021, dt 31.07.2023)
amount_in_dispute: Electricity Duty benefit Rs 5,85,439.30; deposit Rs 5,988.20
key_provision_interpreted: EA s.142 enforcement of CGRF order + Electricity-Duty exemption under Industrial Policy 2004
relief_granted: Discom directed to extend electricity-duty benefit / adjust Rs 5,85,439.30 per CGRF order
ratio_short: A licensee is bound to implement a CGRF direction granting electricity-duty exemption under the applicable Industrial Policy; the Ombudsman will enforce compliance and direct the licensee to extend the benefit and adjust the amount.

petitioner: Sri Alok Kumar @ Alok Sharma (OXY Homes, Flat A-508)
connection_type: Single-point supply / deemed franchisee (builder-society), prepaid sub-meter
primary_subject: Franchisee / society over-recovery via prepaid billing (DG/maintenance/AMC/penalties)
secondary_subjects: Consumer definition s.2(15); billing transparency; separate metering of common areas
procedural_posture: Appeal from CGRF u/s 42(6) (CGRF Loni Complaint 01/2025, dt 25.04.2026, dismissed on consumer-definition)
disposition: Dismissed as withdrawn; liberty to refile before CGRF with proper party
maintainability_holding: Not decided (withdrawn); CGRF had held appellant not a 'consumer'
supply_code_clauses: 4.46(b)(i) - 'no profit, no loss' for deemed franchisee / single-point supply
precedents_cited: Hari Chand v. Haryana Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Ltd. (NCDRC)
key_provision_interpreted: EA s.2(15) 'consumer' (beneficial-user question) + Supply Code cl.4.46(b)(i)
relief_granted: None (liberty to refile in registered owner's name)
ratio_short: Not decided on merits - disposed on withdrawal with liberty to refile before CGRF in the registered owner's name. Records (undecided): whether a beneficial user/occupier is a 'consumer' u/s 2(15); whether a deemed franchisee may recover only on a no-profit-no-loss basis u/cl.4.46(b)(i).
tags: consumer-definition-2(15); single-point-supply; deemed-franchisee-4.46; no-profit-no-loss; withdrawn-liberty; builder-society-recovery

petitioner: M/s J.K. Industries (prop. Mrs. Seema Jaiswal)
primary_subject: Supply reliability / hours of supply (6h -> 2h) -> compensation claim
secondary_subjects: Standards-of-Performance compensation; permanent disconnection for dues
procedural_posture: Direct complaint to Ombudsman after HC writ withdrawn with liberty (Writ-C 12243/2025, dt 09.01.2026)
decided_on: Maintainability - no original jurisdiction / non-exhaustion of remedy
disposition: Dismissed as not maintainable (at this stage); liberty to file afresh after CGRF/SoP remedy
maintainability_holding: Not maintainable (no original jurisdiction; remedy not exhausted)
amount_in_dispute: compensation claim Rs 7.5 crore; outstanding dues Rs 2,14,119
key_provision_interpreted: SoP Regs 2019 cl.8.4.4 + Ombudsman's appellate-only jurisdiction (must exhaust CGRF)
ratio_short: The Ombudsman has only appellate/supervisory jurisdiction over the CGRF and no original jurisdiction; a consumer claiming compensation for deficient standards of performance must first invoke cl.8 of the UPERC (Standards of Performance) Regulations, 2019 before the CGRF; a High Court's 'liberty to approach the Ombudsman' does not confer jurisdiction the forum otherwise lacks.
tags: no-original-jurisdiction; appellate-only; exhaust-cgrf-first; sop-compensation-clause8; hc-liberty-no-jurisdiction; supply-hours

petitioner: Sri Manoj Garg s/o late V.N. Garg (45/78 Civil Lines)
primary_subject: Non-compliance of prior order (CGRF SoP compensation)
procedural_posture: Non-compliance / execution of CGRF order (KESCO Kanpur, Complaint Com./2025, dt 24-04-2026)
key_provision_interpreted: SoP Regs 2019 (compensation) - enforcement of CGRF award
relief_granted: Rs 7,500 SoP compensation confirmed paid; grievance on cheque-delivery left to SoP Regs 2019
ratio_short: Where a CGRF has awarded SoP compensation and the licensee has paid it, the representation is disposed as complied; a grievance over the manner of payment is left to the SoP Regulations 2019.

petitioner: Sri Raju Chadha s/o Bal Krishna Chadha (06 Uptron, Dadanagar)
procedural_posture: Appeal from CGRF u/s 42(6) (CGRF Mandal-II KESCO, Complaint 18/2025, dt 08-09-2025)
disposition: Directed relief - assessment tariff corrected (partly allowed)
key_provision_interpreted: Supply Code 2005 cl 5.5(b)(ii) - licensee's duty of periodic meter check
relief_granted: Tariff in assessment bill corrected; revised (reduced) bill; 5 interest-free installments; action vs officials; pole meter to be replaced
ratio_short: Where the licensee fails its duty to check the meter periodically (Supply Code 2005 cl 5.5(b)(ii)) and thereby saddles the consumer with a delayed assessment, the assessment tariff is corrected/reduced, payment allowed in interest-free installments, and the licensee directed to act against negligent officials and replace the meter.

petitioner: Sri N.K. Gupta s/o S.R. Gupta (57-A Dadanagar)
procedural_posture: Appeal from CGRF (KESCO Mandal, Complaint C2/2025, dt 15-10-2025)
key_provision_interpreted: Supply Code 2005 cl 5.5(b)(iii) - biennial meter check duty
relief_granted: Assessment revised (reduced); 5 interest-free installments; action vs officials; pole meter to be installed
ratio_short: Same rule as OMB-007: a ~9-year gap in meter-checking breaches Supply Code 2005 cl 5.5(b)(iii); the assessment is revised, installments allowed, and the licensee directed to act against officials and install a pole meter.

petitioner: Sri _ Kumar s/o Antu (village & post Suswahi, PS Lanka)
disposition: Directed relief (partial) - surcharge upheld, OTS+security adjusted
amount_in_dispute: revised bill Rs 60,359 + surcharge Rs 9,657 = Rs 70,016; deposited Rs 24,100; final ~Rs 44,216 after deductions
key_provision_interpreted: Supply Code 2005 cl 4.38(ii) (surcharge not waivable) + equity on OTS-2017 deposit
relief_granted: Surcharge upheld; Rs 4,000 (OTS 2017) + Rs 1,100 (security) credited -> final payment ~Rs 44,216
ratio_short: A surcharge computed under Supply Code 2005 cl 4.38(ii) cannot be waived; but an amount the consumer deposited under a prior OTS (which the licensee failed to bill then) must be credited; final dues adjusted accordingly.

petitioner: Smt. Sanobar Wasim w/o Mukhtar Wasim (288 Kishor Bazar, Biharipur)
primary_subject: Non-compliance of prior order (CGRF SoP penalty) + forum-competence
secondary_subjects: Standards of Performance; which forum level hears SoP
procedural_posture: Non-compliance / execution of CGRF order (Bareilly Kshetra Forum, Complaint 04/2024, dt 19-03-2025)
regulations_cited: SoP Regs 2019; UPERC CGRF Regs 2022 (forum-level competence)
key_provision_interpreted: CGRF Regs 2022 - only Company-level forum (not Zonal/Chief Engineer) may hear SoP complaints
relief_granted: Rs 3,330 SoP penalty being paid; representation disposed
ratio_short: SoP complaints are triable only by the Company-level forum under the UPERC CGRF Regulations 2022; a Zonal/Chief-Engineer-level forum hearing them acts beyond competence; all forums directed to route SoP complaints to Company-level forums. On facts, the CGRF penalty being paid, the matter is disposed.
